headline.title: First flakes for White Mountains.
headline.text: Up to {{s:1}} on the summit of Cannon Sunday morning to Sunday afternoon, and {{s:2}} for the week. None of the resorts close to opening get cold enough to make snow this week. Killington typically opens first, around Nov 8.

BTV.excerpt:
Near record high temperatures are expected on Wednesday with mostly sunny conditions and some localized fire weather concerns.
A weak cold front will produce scattered showers on Thursday, but precipitation amounts will be light with highest amounts in the mountains.
Repeated chances for showers this weekend and early next week with temperatures gradually decreasing towards seasonal levels.

ALY.excerpt:
) Above normal temperatures and mainly dry weather expected through Wednesday.
) A cold front will bring chances for some beneficial showers Thursday, followed by additional chances for rain Fri into the weekend with the greatest probabilities south and east of the Capital District.

GYX.excerpt:
A warm front lifts through the region bringing both chances for very light rain this evening and overnight and near-record warm temperatures Wednesday.
A widespread soaking rainfall is possible for the late week into the weekend along a slow moving frontal boundary.

BUF.excerpt:
) Near record warmth Wednesday with dry weather continuing through late afternoon.
) Showers return Wednesday night, with unsettled weather and cooler temperatures lasting through next weekend.

PHI.excerpt:
Patchy fog possible late tonight/early tomorrow morning. No significant weather otherwise through Wednesday.
A slow moving cold front approaches the area Thursday night into Friday bringing the potential for heavy rain to portions of the area.

CTP.excerpt:
) Unseasonably mild through Friday with 2-week dry spell coming to an end
) Trending cooler this weekend with showers downwind of Lake Erie

RLX.excerpt:
) A cold front brings showers and possible thunderstorms for Wednesday into Thursday.
) Cooler temperatures in store this weekend into the next work week with frost/freeze conditions looking probable.

writeups.name: Vermont
writeups.title: Quiet and mild.
paras: Next two days: summit temperatures from {{t:45}} to {{t:63}}, with rain at times.
Killington usually opens first here, around Nov 8. Nights stay too mild to make much snow this week.
NWS Burlington forecasters, Tuesday 6:40 PM: "Near record high temperatures are expected on Wednesday with mostly sunny conditions and some localized fire weather concerns."
writeups.outlook: Days 8 to 14: NOAA's outlook leans slightly warmer than normal and slightly drier than normal.
